title: Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew made with tender lamb and mediterranean spices. This flavorful tagine is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the lamb and sauce over couscous or rice.
